makers-458831.summary: KYORITSU KEW 3125A High Voltage Insulation Tester (Made in Thailand) delivers precise insulation testing up to 5kV with advanced PI/DAR diagnostics.

blocks.text: KYORITSU KEW 3125A High Voltage Insulation Tester (Made In THAILAND)

The KYORITSU KEW 3125A High Voltage Insulation Tester (Made In THAILAND) is a robust handheld instrument designed for evaluating the insulation integrity of electrical equipment by applying DC test voltages up to 5000 V. It enables maintenance personnel to verify insulation resistance up to the terohm range (up to 1 TΩ on the highest range), making it suitable for heavy-duty diagnostics on cables, switchgear, transformers, motors, and other high-voltage components. The instrument integrates safety features and ergonomic design to support field operations under varied conditions.

The tester offers multiple voltage ranges (250 V, 500 V, 1000 V, 2500 V, and for the 3125A an additional 5000 V range), with autoranging insulation measurement up to 1 TΩ. It incorporates auto-discharge to safely bleed off capacitive charge post-test, a voltage monitor to confirm discharge, and diagnostic functions including Polarization Index (PI) and Dielectric Absorption Ratio (DAR) measurements for deeper insulation condition assessment. A bar graph and digital display with backlight enhance readability, while live-circuit warning (audible/visible) prevents inadvertent testing on energized circuits. Auto-power-off conserves battery life during inactivity.

Ergonomically arranged controls and protective fingerguards facilitate safe handling. The instrument meets IEC safety standards (IEC 61010-1/2-030, CAT IV 300 V/CAT III 600 V) and includes guard terminal support to suppress surface leakage in cable tests. Its sturdy hard case and battery operation (eight LR14 C-cells) allow reliable use in various field environments. Clear guidance in the manual emphasizes precautions (e.g., verifying no residual voltage before connection, using proper probes), ensuring user safety during high-voltage measurements.

microohm-22.summary: Arduino Uno R3 Board without Cable High Quality Micro-controller : ATmega328. Operating Voltage : 5V. Input Voltage (recommended) : 7-12V. Digital I/O Pins : 14 (of which 6 provide PWM output). Analog Input Pins : 6.

blocks.text: BUY Arduino Uno R3 Board without Cable in Egypt

The Uno R3 without Cable is a micro-controller board base on the ATmega328 (datasheet). It has 14 digital input/output pins (of which 6 can be used as PWM outputs); 6 analog inputs, a 16 MHz ceramic resonator, a USB connection, a power jack, an ICSP header, and a reset button.It contains everything need to support the microcontroller; simply connect it to a computer with a USB cable or power it with an AC-to-DC adapter or battery to get started.“Uno” means one in Italian and is the name to mark the upcoming release of Arduino 1.0. The Uno and version 1.0 will be the reference versions of Arduino, moving forward. The Uno is the latest in a series of USB Arduino boards and the reference model for the Arduino platform; for a comparison with previous versions, see the index of Arduino boards.

Note: The Uno R3 reference design can use an Atmega8, 168, or 328, Current models use an ATmega328, but an Atmega8 is shown in the schematic for reference. The pin configuration is identical on all three processors.
The Uno R3 can be powered via the USB connection or with an external power supply. The power source is selected automatically.

External (non-USB) power can come either from an AC-to-DC adapter (wall-wart) or battery. The adapter can be connected by plugging a 2.1mm center-positive plug into the board’s power jack. Leads from a battery can be inserted in the Gnd and Vin pin headers of the POWER connector.

The board can operate on an external supply of 6 to 20 volts. If supplied with less than 7V, however, the 5V pin may supply less than five volts and the board may be unstable. If using more than 12V, the voltage regulator may overheat and damage the board. The recommended range is 7 to 12 volts.
The power pins are as follows

VIN. The input voltage to the Arduino board when it’s using an external power source (as opposed to 5 volts from the USB connection or another regulated power source). You can supply voltage through this pin, or, if supplying voltage via the power jack, access it through this pin.

5V.This pin outputs a regulated 5V from the regulator on the board. The board can be supplied with power either from the DC power jack (7 – 12V), the USB connector (5V), or the VIN pin of the board (7-12V). Supplying voltage via the 5V or 3.3V pins bypasses the regulator, and can damage your board. We don’t advise it.
3V3. A 3.3 volt supply generated by the onboard regulator. The maximum current draw is 50 mA.

IOREF. This pin on the Arduino board provides the voltage reference with which the microcontroller operates. A properly configured shield can read the IOREF pin voltage and select the appropriate power source or enable voltage translators on the outputs for working with the 5V or 3.3V.
The ATmega328 has 32 KB (with 0.5 KB used for the bootloader). It also has 2 KB of SRAM and 1 KB of EEPROM (which can be read and written with the EEPROM library).
Input and Output of Arduino uno

Each of the 14 digital pins on the Uno can be used as an input or output, using pinMode(), digitalWrite(), and digitalRead() functions. They operate at 5 volts. Each pin can provide or receive a maximum of 40 mA and has an internal pull-up resistor (disconnected by default) of 20-50 kOhms. In addition, some pins have specialized functions:
Serial: 0 (RX) and 1 (TX). Used to receive (RX) and transmit (TX) TTL serial data. These pins are connected to the corresponding pins of the ATmega8U2 USB-to-TTL Serial chip.
External Interrupts 2 and 3. These pins can be configured to trigger an interrupt on a low value, a rising or falling edge, or a change in value. See the attachInterrupt() function for details.
PWM: 3, 5, 6, 9, 10, and 11. Provide 8-bit PWM output with the analogWrite() function.
SPI: 10 (SS), 11 (MOSI), 12 (MISO), 13 (SCK). These pins support SPI communication using the SPI library.
LED: 13. There is a built-in LED connected to digital pin 13. When the pin is HIGH value, the LED is on, when the pin is LOW, it’s off.

The Uno R3 has 6 analog inputs, labeled A0 through A5, each of which provides 10 bits of resolution (i.e. 1024 different values). By default, they measure from ground to 5 volts, though is it possible to change the upper end of their range using the AREF pin and the analogReference() function. Additionally, some pins have specialized functionality:
TWI: A4 or SDA pin and A5 or SCL pin. Support TWI communication using the Wire library.
There are a couple of other pins on the board:
AREF. A reference voltage for the analog inputs. Used with analogReference().
Reset. Bring this line LOW to reset the microcontroller. Typically used to add a reset button to shields which block the one on the board.
See also the mapping between Arduino pins and ATmega328 ports. The mapping for the Atmega8, 168, and 328 is identical.

The Uno R3 has a number of facilities for communicating with a computer, another Arduino, or other microcontrollers. The ATmega328 provides UART TTL (5V) serial communication, which is available on digital pins 0 (RX) and 1 (TX). An ATmega16U2 on the board channels this serial communication over USB and appears as a virtual com port to software on the computer. The ’16U2 firmware uses the standard USB COM drivers, and no external driver is needed. However, on Windows, a .inf file is required. The Arduino software includes a serial monitor which allows simple textual data to be sent to and from the Arduino board. The RX and TX LEDs on the board will flash when data is being transmitted via the USB-to-serial chip and USB connection to the computer (but not for serial communication on pins 0 and 1).
A SoftwareSerial library allows for serial communication on any of the Uno’s digital pins.

The ATmega328 also supports I2C (TWI) and SPI communication. The Uno R3 software includes a Wire library to simplify use of the I2C bus; see the documentation for details. For SPI communication, use the SPI library.

makers-489488.summary: The MAX192BCPP is a low-power, 8-channel, 10-bit serial ADC with a 133k samples/sec rate, internal reference, and a +5V single supply in a 20-pin DIP package.

blocks.text: The MAX192BCPP is a fully integrated, low-cost data-acquisition system. It combines an 8-channel multiplexer, a high-bandwidth track/hold circuit, and a successive-approximation ADC onto a single chip. This integration simplifies the process of converting multiple analog signals into a digital serial data stream, requiring only a single +5V power supply for operation. The device is designed for ease of use in various measurement and control systems.

A key aspect of the MAX192BCPP is its software-configurable analog inputs, which can be set up for either 8-channel single-ended or 4-channel differential operation. This pseudo-differential input structure allows for versatile signal measurement. Furthermore, the device includes a built-in 4.096V voltage reference, which can be used directly or bypassed in favor of an external, more precise reference to meet specific accuracy requirements.

Data is output through a versatile 4-wire serial interface that is directly compatible with standard protocols like SPI and Microwire, facilitating easy connection to microprocessors. To enhance power efficiency in portable or low-power applications, the MAX192BCPP features multiple power-down modes, including a hardwired shutdown pin and two software-selectable options, allowing the supply current to be drastically reduced between conversions.

makers-466355.summary: ULN2004AN is a 7‑channel, 500 mA Darlington transistor array in a 16‑pin DIP, with built‑in clamp diodes for inductive‑load switching and CMOS inputs.

blocks.text: The ULN2004AN device is a high‑voltage, high‑current Darlington transistor array housed in a 16‑lead dual‑in‑line package. Internally, it comprises seven NPN Darlington pairs, each pre‑biased with series resistors and integrated clamp diodes to simplify interfacing and protect against inductive kick‑back when switching loads. By integrating the driver transistors, base resistors, and fly‑back diodes into a single monolithic IC, the ULN2004AN streamlines PCB design and reduces component count.

Each Darlington channel is rated for a collector‑emitter voltage of up to 50 V and can sink continuous currents of up to 500 mA. Channels may be paralleled to achieve higher aggregate current. The common‑cathode clamp diode arrangement allows up to seven inductive loads such as relays, solenoids, or lamps to share a single COM pin connection, simplifying power‑rail routing and ensuring robust suppression of back‑EMF.

The ULN2004AN variant features 10.5 kΩ series base resistors, optimizing its input‑current requirements for direct drive from 6 V to 15 V CMOS logic. Compared to the ULN2003A (2.7 kΩ) and ULN2002A (Zener‑protected) devices, the ULN2004AN draws less input current and operates at lower input voltages, making it ideal for modern microcontroller and DSP interfaces.
Integrated common‑cathode clamp diodes for inductive‑load protection.

It converts parallel data from a microprocessor into serial data for transmission and converts received serial data back into parallel form for processing. This IC became widely used in early computer systems, terminals, industrial controllers, and embedded applications requiring reliable asynchronous communication.

Housed in a 40-pin wide DIP package, the INS8250N provides programmable communication parameters such as baud rate, data bits, parity, and stop bits. It includes transmit and receive buffering, status registers, and interrupt support, making it suitable for interfacing with RS-232 drivers, modems, printers, terminals, and other serial peripherals. The device remains popular for retro-computing projects, industrial equipment maintenance, and educational applications involving UART communication.

makers-389377.summary: The MN4164P-15A is a 64Kx1bit NMOS dynamic RAM in a 16-pin DIP. It requires a single 5V supply, multiplexed addressing, and periodic refresh.

blocks.text: MN4164P-15A NMOS 65,536 x 1 Bit Dynamic RAM DIP 16-Pin

The MN4164P-15A is a dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) integrated circuit that provides 65,536 bits of data storage, organized as a single 65,536 x 1 bit array. Built using NMOS technology, it stores each bit of data as an electrical charge in a tiny capacitor within a memory cell. This dynamic storage mechanism requires the data to be periodically refreshed to maintain integrity, a key characteristic of DRAMs that allows for high-density memory structures.

This RAM is designed for easy integration into digital systems, operating from a single +5V power supply. It features a multiplexed address bus, where the 16 address bits needed to access any of the 64K locations are supplied over 8 pins, using the Row Address Strobe (RAS) and Column Address Strobe (CAS) signals to latch the row and column addresses respectively. This multiplexing significantly reduces the number of pins required, leading to a compact 16-pin DIP package.

The device supports several flexible operating modes controlled by the RAS, CAS, and WRITE pins. These include standard Read and Write cycles, a Read-Modify-Write cycle for atomic operations, and a Page Mode for faster access to multiple bits within the same row. The data output is tri-state, going into a high-impedance state when not active, allowing it to be connected directly to a shared system data bus.

blocks.text: SR04M-2 Waterproof Ultrasonic Distance Sensor Module 5V 25-450cm

The SR04M-2 Waterproof Ultrasonic Distance Sensor Module is designed for non-contact distance measurement in environments where a conventional open ultrasonic transducer may be exposed to moisture, dust, or outdoor conditions. The system separates the ultrasonic sensing probe from the electronic control board, allowing the probe to be positioned at the measurement point while the PCB remains protected in a suitable enclosure.

The module determines distance by transmitting an ultrasonic pulse and measuring the time required for the reflected sound wave to return from the target. A single enclosed ultrasonic transducer is used for both transmitting and receiving. The control board processes the returned signal and provides a pulse-width output that can be read by a microcontroller to calculate the distance.

The SR04M-2 can be integrated into Arduino and other microcontroller-based systems using a trigger-and-echo style interface similar to common ultrasonic ranging modules. Its remote probe configuration makes it particularly useful where the sensing point needs to be separated from the main electronics. The control board itself should remain protected from water and environmental exposure even when the external ultrasonic probe is installed in a wet location.

blocks.text: Mijing SW-03 Rosin Atomizer Mainboard Short Circuit Detector Pen

The Mijing SW-03 Rosin Atomizer Mainboard Short Circuit Detector Pen is a specialized diagnostic tool used in electronic repair to help locate short circuits visually. It is especially useful for mobile phone motherboard repair, tablet PCB troubleshooting, and compact board diagnostics where the fault area is too small to detect by touch or visual inspection alone.

During short-circuit diagnosis, technicians often inject controlled voltage into the suspected power rail and then look for the component or area that heats first. The Mijing SW-03 Rosin Atomizer Mainboard Short Circuit Detector Pen helps make this heat visible. It atomizes small particles of rosin and produces smoke that can be directed over the board. When the smoke passes over the hot component, the behavior of the smoke and rosin residue helps reveal the faulty area faster.

This tool is not a thermal camera replacement, but it is a practical, affordable, and bench-friendly short-circuit detection aid. It is useful when working under a microscope and can save time during fault tracing, especially on dense motherboards where power ICs, capacitors, filters, and small SMD components are located very close together.
The main purpose of the Mijing SW-03 Rosin Atomizer Mainboard Short Circuit Detector Pen is to assist with short-circuit detection by using rosin smoke as a visual indicator.

Instead of applying heat directly with a soldering iron, the technician places small rosin particles inside the atomizer chamber. When the pen is powered through USB and the button is pressed, the internal coil heats the rosin and creates visible smoke. This smoke is then directed toward the suspected board area.

When the board is powered through a current-limited power supply, the shorted area normally heats faster than the surrounding area. The rosin smoke helps show where the heat is concentrated, making the short easier to find.
This workflow is commonly used in mobile repair, especially for:
unknown hot spots on phone motherboards,

The Mijing SW-03 Rosin Atomizer Mainboard Short Circuit Detector Pen is the SW-03 no-battery model. It does not include an internal rechargeable battery. The USB port is used to power the device directly during operation.
The SW-03 does not work without USB power.
The SW-03 does not charge internally.
Leaving it connected for a long time will not charge a battery, because this version has no built-in battery.
It should be connected to a stable 5V USB power supply.
Avoid excessive voltage or unsuitable fast-charging outputs.
A good-quality USB cable is recommended for stable operation.

If the pen lights up, heats for a short time, and then stops, this may be part of the normal timed heating behavior, especially when used in short bursts. However, if it does not heat at all, does not produce smoke with proper rosin particles, or keeps cutting off immediately, the USB power source, cable, and atomizer coil should be checked.

The Mijing SW-03 Rosin Atomizer Mainboard Short Circuit Detector Pen works by heating rosin particles inside the atomizer chamber. The atomizer section includes a glass tank, a heating coil, a base, and a drip outlet.
Connect the pen to a 5V USB power supply.
Add small crushed rosin particles into the atomizer chamber.
Press the power button to heat the coil.
Wait briefly until rosin smoke appears.
Direct the glass hood outlet toward the suspected PCB area.
Power the suspected rail using a safe, current-limited bench power supply.
Watch the board under a microscope to identify the hot spot.

The pen should be used vertically downward for better smoke direction and more stable atomization. For best results, the working area should have no strong airflow, because wind or ventilation may push the smoke away from the target area and reduce detection accuracy.

blocks.text: Herigo HR-018 20000mAh 22.5W Fast Charging Power Bank with Digital Display and Built-in Cables

Herigo HR-018 Power Bank is a high-capacity portable charging solution designed for long trips, daily backup power, emergency charging, and outdoor use. With a large 20000mAh battery capacity, 22.5W fast charging support, built-in Type-C and Lightning cables, USB-A output, Type-C input and output, and an intelligent LED digital display, this power bank is built to keep modern devices powered with less cable clutter and better charging convenience.

The Herigo HR-018 combines a large 20000mAh capacity with a compact modern body and an easy-carry side loop. It is suitable for users who need a reliable power source for smartphones, tablets, wireless earbuds, accessories, and compatible USB-powered devices while traveling, working, studying, camping, hiking, fishing, or moving between locations. The product is designed to reduce the need for separate charging cables by including built-in Type-C and Lightning cable outputs, while also providing external output ports for additional charging flexibility.

According to the supplied images and package details, the HR-018 supports up to 22.5W fast charging and can charge up to four devices simultaneously. The rear specification label shows a 20000mAh battery capacity with a 74Wh power rating at 3.7V. The Type-C input supports 5V/3A, 9V/2A, and 12V/1.5A, while the Type-C output supports 5V/3A, 9V/2.22A, and 12V/1.67A. The USB-A output supports fast charging modes up to 22.5W according to the supplied specifications, and the built-in Type-C cable supports 5V/3A, 9V/2.22A, and 12V/1.67A output. The built-in Lightning cable output is rated at 5V/2.1A.

The front digital display clearly shows the remaining battery percentage, which is useful for checking power status before leaving home or during travel. The package side also highlights travel, camping, hiking, fishing, quick charge, high conversion efficiency, universal output support, no memory effect, and a 72-hour safety test claim. Actual charging speed and charging count depend on device compatibility, cable condition, supported charging protocol, device battery health, temperature, and whether multiple devices are connected at the same time.

باور بانك هيريجو اتش ار ٠١٨ بسعة ٢٠٠٠٠ ملي أمبير وشحن سريع ٢٢.٥ وات بشاشة رقمية وكابلات مدمجة

باور بانك هيريجو اتش ار ٠١٨ هو شاحن متنقل بسعة كبيرة ٢٠٠٠٠ ملي أمبير، مصمم للاستخدام اليومي والرحلات الطويلة والسفر والطوارئ. يتميز بدعم الشحن السريع حتى ٢٢.٥ وات، مع كابلات مدمجة، وشاشة رقمية ذكية تعرض نسبة البطارية، وتصميم أزرق فاتح أنيق مزود بحلقة جانبية لتسهيل الحمل.

هذا الموديل مناسب للمستخدم الذي يحتاج باور بانك قوي بسعة كبيرة يمكن الاعتماد عليه لفترات أطول من الموديلات الصغيرة. سعة ٢٠٠٠٠ ملي أمبير تجعله مناسبًا للموبايلات والتابلت والسماعات اللاسلكية والساعات الذكية والإكسسوارات المتوافقة، سواء أثناء الشغل أو الدراسة أو السفر أو الرحلات الخارجية.

طبقًا للصور والبيانات المرسلة، يحتوي باور بانك هيريجو اتش ار ٠١٨ على كابل تايب سي مدمج وكابل لايتنينج مدمج، بالإضافة إلى مدخل ومخرج تايب سي ومخرج عادي. يدعم المنتج الشحن السريع حتى ٢٢.٥ وات كحد أقصى، ويمكنه شحن حتى أربعة أجهزة في نفس الوقت طبقًا لبيانات العبوة، مع ملاحظة أن سرعة الشحن تتأثر بعدد الأجهزة المتصلة وإجمالي القدرة المتاحة.

blocks.text: WAGO F13 Wire Connector 1 In 3 Out – Compact Spring Lever Distribution Connector
WAGO F13 Wire Connector 1 In 3 Out

The WAGO F13 Wire Connector is a practical and compact solution for electrical installations that require one incoming wire to be distributed into multiple outgoing lines safely and neatly. With its 1 input and 3 output configuration, this connector is especially useful for branch wiring, parallel distribution, and organized cable routing in compact electrical setups.

This WAGO wire connector uses a spring lever clamping mechanism, allowing wires to be inserted and locked quickly without twisting, soldering, or using screw terminals. This makes installation faster, reduces wiring effort, and simplifies future maintenance or rewiring. Each conductor is clamped individually, which helps provide secure wire holding and stable long-term electrical contact.

The WAGO F13 is suitable for solid, stranded, and flexible conductors, making it practical for lighting circuits, distribution points, junction boxes, switchboards, control systems, low-voltage installations, and general electrical projects. Its compact body helps save space while keeping the wiring layout clean and organized.

The housing is made from insulating material suitable for practical electrical use. The connector is designed for reliable low-voltage electrical performance and convenient repeated use when wiring changes are needed. It is commonly available with orange lever handles, depending on stock and production batch.

If you need a compact distribution connector that combines quick lever operation, reusable design, secure wire grip, and simple 1-to-3 branching, the WAGO F13 is a practical choice for many electrical wiring applications.

جسم الموصل مصنوع من خامة عازلة مناسبة للاستخدام الكهربائي العملي، ويأتي هذا الموديل غالبًا بمقابض باللون البرتقالي حسب النسخة المعروضة، مع ثبات نفس الوظيفة الأساسية والمواصفات العامة.

blocks.text: Wheel 85×38mm Off-Road Robot Wheel with 4mm Hex Metal Coupler (Multi Colors)

The 85×38mm Off-Road Robot Wheel with 4mm Hex Metal Coupler is a practical drive wheel for robot cars, smart vehicles, and DIY motion projects that need stronger grip and a larger wheel size than standard mini robot wheels. This version is supplied as one complete wheel with one metal coupler, making it suitable for builders who want a ready-to-mount solution for a custom drivetrain or robotic chassis.

The wheel has an outer diameter of 85mm and a width of 38mm, which gives it a stable footprint and better ground contact during movement. This makes it more suitable for rougher surfaces, uneven floors, and mobile robot platforms that need improved traction. The outer tire is made of rubber, which helps reduce slipping and provides more confident movement during acceleration, turning, and general driving.

The rim is made from high-strength reinforced plastic, giving the wheel a good balance between durability and low weight. The structure is designed to handle repeated use in robotics applications while staying light enough for smart car and educational builds. The internal wheel body is paired with a metal motor coupler, which helps connect the wheel more securely to the shaft setup used in the project.

This product includes a 4mm hex motor coupler with 30mm length and an outer diameter of 11mm. That makes it a useful option in robotic platforms that need a stronger and more stable wheel connection compared with direct plastic-fit wheels. The coupler helps improve mounting rigidity and gives the builder more flexibility in matching the wheel with compatible motor shafts or custom drive arrangements.

The wheel is available with two rim color options: Silver or Blue, while the tire is always black. This makes it easy to match the product visually with different robot chassis styles while keeping the same practical off-road grip pattern.

عجلة روبوت أوف رود 85×38 مم مع كابلر معدني هكس 4 مم هي عجلة عملية مخصصة للعربات الذكية ومشروعات الروبوت التي تحتاج مقاس أكبر وتماسك أقوى من العجلات الصغيرة المعتادة. المنتج يأتي في صورة عجلة واحدة مع كابلر معدني واحد، وده يجعله مناسبًا للمشروعات التي يتم فيها تجميع نظام الحركة حسب التصميم المطلوب.

العجلة بقطر 85 مم وعرض 38 مم، وبالتالي توفر مساحة تلامس جيدة مع الأرض وتساعد على ثبات أفضل أثناء الحركة. هذا المقاس مناسب جدًا للعربات الروبوتية التي تحتاج أداء أفضل على الأسطح غير المثالية أو الأرضيات التي تحتاج قبضة أقوى. الكاوتش الخارجي مصنوع ليعطي احتكاك أعلى ويقلل الانزلاق، وده ينعكس بشكل واضح على جودة الحركة والانطلاق واللف.

الجزء الداخلي من العجلة مصنوع من بلاستيك مقوى ليحافظ على التوازن بين المتانة والوزن المناسب، بينما يأتي معها كابلر معدني لتثبيت أفضل وربط أكثر ثباتًا مع محور الحركة. وجود الكابلر المعدني مهم في التطبيقات التي تحتاج تركيب أقوى من الحلول البلاستيكية البسيطة، خصوصًا في العربات التي تتحمل حركة متكررة أو أحمالًا أعلى نسبيًا.

الكابلر المرفق من نوع هكس 4 مم بطول 30 مم وقطر خارجي 11 مم، وده يجعله مناسبًا لتطبيقات كثيرة في الروبوتات والعربات الذكية، خاصة عندما يكون المطلوب ربط عملي ومحكم بين العجلة ووحدة القيادة أو عمود الحركة.
المنتج متوفر بلونين للحلقة الداخلية: فضي أو أزرق، بينما يظل الإطار الخارجي أسود دائمًا. وده يديك اختيار شكلي مناسب بدون تغيير في الأداء أو المواصفات الأساسية.

blocks.text: GA25-370 DC Gear Motor with Encoder 12V 280RPM 2kg.cm

The GA25-370 DC Gear Motor with Encoder 12V 280RPM 2kg.cm is a compact geared motor designed for motion control applications that need both mechanical output and encoder feedback in one integrated unit. It combines a DC gear motor with a built-in encoder, making it suitable for projects that require speed monitoring, direction detection, and more accurate control compared with ordinary geared motors.

This version is built for 12V DC nominal operation and provides a free-run speed of 280RPM, making it a faster option for projects that need more output speed while still keeping the benefits of a reduction gearbox. It is well suited for robotics, automation, smart motion systems, wheeled platforms, and embedded control projects where smooth movement and real-time feedback are important.

The integrated encoder makes this motor especially useful in systems that rely on closed-loop control. It can help the controller track motor movement, measure rotation, estimate speed, and improve synchronization between multiple motors. This is very useful in mobile robots, precise drive systems, educational mechatronics setups, and automated mechanisms that need better movement accuracy.

The motor uses a D-shaped output shaft, which helps secure couplers, wheels, hubs, and mechanical linkages more firmly than a plain round shaft. The geared structure improves usable torque while reducing the raw motor speed to a more practical level for mechanical applications.

This product is supplied as the motor with encoder and attached wires only. It does not include any bracket, holder, or mounting frame. That makes it suitable for users who already have a custom mounting solution or want to install it directly into their own chassis or mechanism.

With its combination of compact size, useful speed, encoder feedback, and practical torque, this motor is a strong option for engineers, students, makers, and technicians working on controlled motion systems.
Product Type: DC Gear Motor with Encoder
Wiring: Motor and encoder wires included

موتور جيربوكس جي ايه ٢٥-٣٧٠ بإنكودر ١٢ فولت ٢٨٠ لفة في الدقيقة وعزم ٢ كجم.سم

موتور جيربوكس جي ايه ٢٥-٣٧٠ بإنكودر ١٢ فولت ٢٨٠ لفة في الدقيقة وعزم ٢ كجم.سم هو حل عملي للمشروعات التي تحتاج حركة أسرع نسبيًا مع إمكانية متابعة السرعة والاتجاه واللفات من خلال الإنكودر المدمج. هذا النوع مناسب جدًا عندما تحتاج موتور جيربوكس فيه خرج ميكانيكي مستقر، وفي نفس الوقت تريد قراءة فعلية لحركة الموتور داخل المشروع.

يعمل الموتور على ١٢ فولت تيار مستمر، ويعطي سرعة بدون حمل تصل إلى ٢٨٠ لفة في الدقيقة، لذلك هو مناسب للتطبيقات التي تحتاج سرعة أعلى من نسخ الجيربوكس الأبطأ، مع الاحتفاظ بميزة التحكم الأفضل التي يوفرها الإنكودر. هذا يجعله مناسبًا لعربات الروبوت، وأنظمة الحركة الذكية، والتطبيقات التعليمية، والمشروعات التي تعتمد على قياس الحركة أثناء التشغيل.

الميزة الأساسية في هذا المنتج هي وجود إنكودر مدمج، وده معناه إنك تقدر تتابع دوران الموتور بشكل أدق، سواء لحساب السرعة أو معرفة الاتجاه أو تحسين التحكم داخل النظام. وده مهم جدًا في المشاريع التي تعتمد على الضبط، مثل الروبوتات المتحركة، وأنظمة تتبع المسافة، وبعض تطبيقات الأتمتة والميكاترونكس.

الموتور مزود بعمود خرج على شكل دي، وده يسهل تثبيت العجلة أو الكوبلن أو أي وصلة ميكانيكية بشكل أكثر ثباتًا، ويقلل احتمالية الانزلاق أثناء التشغيل. كما أن وجود الجيربوكس يجعل الخرج أنسب للتطبيقات الميكانيكية من الموتور العادي المباشر، لأن السرعة تكون أكثر عملية والعزم أفضل للاستخدام الفعلي.
المنتج هنا يأتي بالموتور مع الإنكودر والأسلاك فقط، من غير أي براكت أو حامل تثبيت. وده مناسب لو حضرتك عندك بالفعل طريقة تثبيت خاصة بمشروعك أو شاسيه مخصص تريد تركب عليه الموتور مباشرة.
ولو مشروعك يحتاج موتور جيربوكس بسرعة جيدة مع إمكانية قراءة الحركة والتحكم فيها بشكل أفضل، فهذه النسخة تعتبر اختيار مناسب جدًا، خصوصًا في التطبيقات التعليمية والروبوتية والأنظمة الذكية الصغيرة.

blocks.text: The R280 Brushed DC Motor 3-12V 13750RPM is a compact and practical high-speed motor designed for small electronic, mechanical, and motion-based projects. It is a good choice for applications that require fast rotation, compact size, and simple DC power operation, making it useful for makers, students, technicians, and hobbyists working on lightweight motion systems.

This motor operates over a wide 3V to 12V DC range, which gives it flexibility for different circuit designs and power setups. At the higher end of its voltage range, it can reach speeds up to 13750RPM, making it suitable for projects that need quick and efficient rotary motion. Its performance range allows it to be used in experimental builds, low-voltage mechanical systems, and compact devices where space is limited but rotational speed is still important.

The R280 motor uses a brushed DC design, so it is easy to connect, easy to test, and simple to integrate into many common electronics projects. Its metal body helps provide strength and stability, while the internal copper winding structure supports efficient operation and dependable output for general-purpose applications. With its balance of speed, compact dimensions, stable operation, and easy integration, the R280 Brushed DC Motor is a versatile solution for many general electronics and motion projects. It is especially useful where a compact motor with a 2mm shaft and a broad operating voltage range is required.

موتور تيار مستمر بفرش R280 يعمل من 3 إلى 12 فولت بسرعة تصل إلى 13750 لفة في الدقيقة هو موتور عملي مخصص للتطبيقات الصغيرة والمتوسطة التي تحتاج سرعة دوران جيدة مع حجم مناسب وسهولة في التشغيل. هذا النوع يعتبر اختيار ممتاز في المشاريع التي تعتمد على الحركة الميكانيكية البسيطة أو الأنظمة الصغيرة التي تحتاج موتور مباشر بدون تعقيد في التوصيل أو التحكم.

يتميز هذا الموتور بأنه يعمل على مدى جهد واسع من 3 فولت إلى 12 فولت تيار مستمر، وده يدي مرونة كبيرة جدًا في استخدامه مع أكثر من مصدر تغذية حسب طبيعة المشروع. ومع زيادة الجهد ترتفع السرعة، لذلك هو مناسب للتطبيقات التي تحتاج سرعة عالية نسبيًا، سواء في التجارب العملية أو النماذج الأولية أو المشاريع التعليمية أو استخدامات الهواة.

الموديل R280 يأتي بتصميم بفرش، وده معناه إنه سهل جدًا في التوصيل والتجربة، ومناسب للمشاريع السريعة اللي محتاجة موتور يشتغل مباشرة بمجرد توصيل التغذية. كمان الجسم المعدني بيدي متانة جيدة للموتور، والملفات الداخلية النحاسية تساعد على تشغيل ثابت وأداء عملي في الاستخدامات اليومية الخفيفة والمتوسطة.

الموتور ده ينفع في تطبيقات كثيرة جدًا مثل الطلمبات الصغيرة، والخلاطات أو العصارات الصغيرة، وفرش الأسنان الكهربائية، والألعاب، ومراوح الهواء الصغيرة، وبعض مشاريع الروبوت والحركة. وكمان ينفع في أي مشروع محتاج عمود دوران دائري يمكن تركيبه مع مروحة، أو بكرة، أو وصلة ميكانيكية، أو ترس خفيف حسب التصميم.

ومن أهم مميزاته إنه يجمع بين السرعة العالية، والحجم المناسب، وسهولة التشغيل، وتعدد الاستخدامات، وده يخليه مناسب للمهندسين والفنيين والطلبة والهواة اللي بيشتغلوا على دوائر وتجميعات فيها حركة دورانية. ولو حضرتك محتاج موتور سريع بعمود 2 مم ويقبل نطاق تشغيل واسع، فـ R280 يعتبر اختيار عملي جدًا.

blocks.text: 24V 20Ah High Drain Rechargeable Lithium-ion Battery Pack – 30A Max Output with BMS Protection

24V 20Ah High Drain Rechargeable Lithium-ion Battery Pack is designed for users who need longer runtime and stronger output capability from a compact 24V rechargeable power source. With a rated capacity of 20Ah and a maximum discharge current of up to 30A, this battery pack is suitable for demanding electronic applications that require stable voltage, extended operating time, and reliable high-current delivery.

The battery provides a nominal 24V output and reaches approximately 25.2V when fully charged, making it suitable for many 24V DC systems and portable electronic builds. Compared with smaller capacity packs, the 20Ah capacity gives longer working time for LED systems, routers, portable devices, motors, robotics, backup systems, and DIY power projects. The 30A maximum output also makes it more suitable for applications that need stronger current during startup or continuous operation.

This battery is built for high drain applications, meaning it can support higher current loads than ordinary low-drain battery packs. This is useful for devices that may require a strong current kick, such as small motors, high-power LED strips, portable tools, and custom 24V equipment. The battery also includes an integrated BMS protection circuit to help protect against overcharge, over-discharge, overcurrent, and short circuit conditions.

The pack is supplied in a compact wrapped assembly with output wiring and a charging connector, making it practical for installation in custom electronics projects, mobile systems, field devices, and workshop applications. It is also made using selected recycled electronic cells, offering a practical and more sustainable energy solution while still delivering useful performance for demanding 24V loads.
Why Choose This 24V 20Ah High Drain Battery?

This battery is a stronger option than the 24V 10Ah version when the application needs longer runtime and higher current capacity. The larger 20Ah capacity allows devices to operate for a longer period before recharging, while the 30A maximum discharge capability provides more headroom for loads that draw higher current. This makes it suitable for projects where both endurance and output strength are important.

microohm-43966.summary: Raspberry Pi 4 Case with Fan Place Black Color High Quality (Fan Included)

blocks.text: Raspberry Pi 4 Case with Fan Place Black Color High Quality (Fan Included )

Since the launch of the Raspberry Pi 4 Model B single-board computer, there are many enclosure or case for it. I like this particularly because it is lightweight, made with ABS, easy to assemble (no screw needed, just snap and fit) and it need cooling fan (requires 4 easy mounting screws) because the Raspberry Pi 4B need it 🙂
We love this case since the version for Raspberry Pi 3B and 3B+, now it’s finally being updated to be compatible with the Raspberry Pi 4 Model B board. And it takes the cooling into consideration.

The case comes in three main parts so you can snap on (no screw). There is a base plane, where you should place the Raspberry Pi 4 board (remove the microSD card first), the middle part which is a rectangular shape part that has opening for connectors (USB ports, Ethernet port, micro HDMI, USB Type C, Audio/Vidoe jack, etc) and partial of the top side; and the last part is the top cover with an opening and mounting holes for cooling fan. The user is free to remove the top cover and access to the connectors of the camera, display, and GPIO.
This case’s smart design and customizability make it a worthy addition to the Pi case genre! The opening allows additional heatsink for the processor, RAM and USB controller:
Note: This product is just the case. It does not come with Raspberry Pi or heatsinks.
Note: The gap between the top cover and middle part is purposely designed to allow airflow for ventilation and cable (GPIO, Camera, Display) access.
In case you are asking about the bottom of the case, here it is. You can access to the MicroSD card easily 🙂
The cooling fan will require mounting with the screws and nuts provided and connect the connector to Pin 4 (Red to 5V) and Pin 6 (Black to GND) as shown in the picture:

We have done the stress test on Raspberry Pi 4 Model B 4GB board. The test is carried out to compare the temperature performance of the Raspberry Pi 4 with this nice ABS case, Fan ON and Fan Off. This is just one of the many methods you can use to benchmark the thermal performance of the enclosure or heatsink. The test consists of two parts which are cooling and continue with stress test. The stress test loads the CPU to 100% and logs the temperature. We have also updated the EEPROM firmware of Raspberry Pi 4 Model B to 000137ad (date: 10 Sep 2019), the thermal performance improved significantly:
As you can see from the chart, the cooling fan plays an important role in keeping the Raspberry Pi cool 🙂 So make sure the fan is there and working if you like this enclosure/case.

Provide flexibility to use the top cover or not
Abandon space for extra heatsink if you want

blocks.text: Tower Pro MG996R 180° High Torque Servo Motor with Full Metal Gears (11Kgm) 180 Degree

The Tower Pro MG996R is a high-torque servo motor built for projects that need stronger output than small plastic-gear servos. With its full metal gear construction, this servo is better suited for repeated motion, heavier mechanical loads, and more demanding robotic applications. It is commonly used in robotic arms, mobile robots, RC steering systems, pan-tilt platforms, grippers, and DIY automation mechanisms.

This servo uses a 3-wire PWM interface, making it easy to control with popular development boards and controllers. The wiring is standard: orange for PWM signal, red for VCC, and brown for GND, as shown in the wiring diagram. The uploaded guide also confirms the common servo control method using a 50Hz PWM signal, with pulse width controlling the position.

The MG996R is widely preferred because it combines high torque, metal gears, and practical size in one body. Compared with lighter servos, it offers better resistance to wear and is more suitable for applications where the output shaft is under repeated stress. Its internal design is intended to improve centering and stability, making it a good option for hobby and semi-professional motion control systems. The guide also notes upgraded shock resistance, improved centering, and a redesigned internal control system over earlier versions.

This version is sold as a Tower Pro MG996R 180° servo with full metal gears, and it comes with multiple servo horns and mounting accessories for easy installation in different mechanical setups. Based on the uploaded dimensions page and product images, the servo is suitable for standard bracket mounting and general robotics integration.

blocks.text: FQPF10N50C High-Voltage N-channel Power MOSFET Transistor

FQPF10N50C is a popular N-Channel Power MOSFET manufactured by Fairchild (nowadays onsemi). This component, commonly known as 10N50C, stands out with its high voltage resistance of 500V and insulated TO-220F sheath. These features make it a safe and practical solution, especially for grid-voltage-operated switching power supplies (SMPS).
High Voltage Capacity: Based on 500V Drain-Source voltage, it can be safely used in power electronic circuits directly connected to the grid.

Insulated TO-220F Sheath: Also known as ‘Full-Pack’, this sheath completely insulates the metal tab of the MOSFET. This allows it to be mounted directly to the cooler without the use of additional mica or silicone pads.
Improved dv/dt Capability: It is resistant to high voltage change rates, which increases the stability of the circuit.
Optimized Switching: It offers high efficiency thanks to its low gate charge (Qg) and optimized switching times.
Wide Range of Uses: Its popularity and robust construction make it a place in a wide range of power electronics applications.

blocks.text: NE555 Delay Monostable Switch Module Time Delay Switch Delay On Vehicle Electrical Delay 12V With optocoupler

This NE555 Delay Monostable Switch Module Time Delay Switch is a timer switch module, based on NE555 chip with high-performance timing CPU design. The power indicator LED and switch trigger timing indication LEDs. Timing from microseconds to long hours.
Applicable to vehicle equipment-delay to prevent car ignition, prevention of high sudden current to burn components and devices.

This is a monostable generator based on NE555 integrated circuit. It has adjustable delay time from 0 to 10 seconds using the potentiometer or by changing the capacitance. It is also capable of controlling device below 220V/10A. The NE555 is a highly stable device for generating accurate time delays or oscillation. Additional terminals are provided for triggering or resetting if desired.

In the time delay mode of operation, the time is precisely controlled by one external resistor and capacitor. For astable operation as an oscillator, the free running frequency and duty cycle are accurately controlled with two external resistors and one capacitor. The circuit may be triggered and reset on falling waveforms , and the output circuit can source or sink up to 200mA or drive TTL circuits.

blocks.text: Arduino® UNO R4 Minima Original Made In ITALY (ABX00080)

Introducing the Arduino UNO R4 Minima! This board boasts the RA4M1 microprocessor from Renesas, delivering increased processing power, expanded memory, and additional peripherals. And the best part? It stays true to the reliable UNO form factor and operates at a practical 5 V voltage. Brace yourself for an upgrade like no other with the Arduino UNO R4 Minima!

Enhanced and improved, the Arduino UNO R4 Minima is armed with a powerful 32-bit microcontroller courtesy of Renesas. Brace yourself for increased processing power, expanded memory, and a whole new level of on-board peripherals. The best part? Compatibility with existing shields and accessories remains intact, and there’s no need to make any changes to the standard form factor or 5 V operating voltage.

Joining the Arduino ecosystem, the UNO R4 is a trusty addition suitable for both beginners and seasoned electronics enthusiasts. Whether you’re just starting out or looking to push the boundaries of your projects, this robust board delivers reliable performance every time
Here’s what the UNO R4 Minima brings to the table

Hardware compatibility with UNO form factor: The UNO R4 Minima maintains the same form factor, pinout, and 5 V operating voltage as its predecessor, the UNO R3. This ensures a seamless transition for existing shields and projects, leveraging the extensive and unique ecosystem already established for the Arduino UNO.

Expanded memory and faster clock: Prepare for more precise calculations and the ability to handle complex projects with ease. The UNO R4 Minima boasts increased memory and a faster clock speed, empowering you to tackle demanding tasks effortlessly.

Extra on-board peripherals: The UNO R4 Minima introduces a range of on-board peripherals, including a 12-bit DAC, CAN BUS, and OP AMP. These additional components provide you with expanded capabilities and flexibility in your designs.

Extended 24 V tolerance: The UNO R4 Minima now supports a wider input voltage range, allowing power supplies up to 24 V. This enables seamless integration with motors, LED strips, and other actuators, simplifying your projects by utilizing a single power source.

SWD connector: Debugging is a critical aspect of any project. Simply connect an external debugger to the UNO R4 Minima and effortlessly monitor the inner workings of your system. Stay in control and gain valuable insights.

HID support: The UNO R4 Minima comes with built-in HID (Human Interface Device) support, enabling it to simulate a mouse or keyboard when connected to a computer via a USB cable. This convenient feature makes it a breeze to send keystrokes and mouse movements to a computer, enhancing usability and functionality.
Get ready to unlock a world of possibilities with the Arduino UNO R4 Minima. Its exceptional features and enhanced capabilities make it the perfect companion for your innovative ventures.

Lora Shield is a long-range transceiver on an Arduino shield form factor and based on an Open source library. The Lora Shield allows the user to send data and reach extremely long ranges at low data rates.It provides ultra-long range spread spectrum communication and high interference immunity whilst minimising current consumption.

The Lora Shield based on RFM95W/RFM98W targets professional wireless sensor network applications such as irrigation systems, smart metering, smart cities, smartphone detection, building automation, and so on.

Using Hope RF’s patented LoRaTM modulation technique the Lora Shield can achieve a sensitivity of over -148dBm using a low-cost crystal and bill of materials. The high sensitivity combined with the integrated +20 dBm power amplifier yields industry leading link budget making it optimal for any application requiring range or robustness. LoRaTM also provides significant advantages in both blocking and selectivity over conventional modulation techniques, solving the traditional design compromise between range, interference immunity and energy consumption.

These devices also support high performance (G)FSK modes for systems including WMBus, IEEE802.15.4g. The Lora Shield deliver exceptional phase noise, selectivity, receiver linearity and IIP3 for significantly lower current consumption than competing devices.

ekostra-14301.summary: 3.3µF capacitance , ideal for signal coupling and bypassing Rated for 50V DC , suitable for low-to-moderate voltage circuits Radial through-hole design for secure PCB mounting Polarized electrolytic type for stable performance Wide operating temperature: -40°C to +105°C Ideal for filtering, decoupling, and audio applications Compact form factor for tight circuit layouts

blocks.text: The 3.3µF 50V radial electrolytic capacitor is a small polarised aluminium capacitor for coupling, decoupling and filtering in low- and medium-voltage circuits. Its value is a common choice for passing audio signals between amplifier stages while blocking DC, for timing networks, and for local smoothing next to ICs and regulators.
Type: aluminium electrolytic, radial leads, through-hole
Polarity: polarised; the negative lead is marked on the sleeve
The longer lead is positive (+); the lead next to the stripe on the sleeve is negative (−).
Connect the positive lead to the point with the higher DC voltage. Reversed polarity can make the capacitor heat up, bulge or burst.
Audio coupling: with a 10KΩ input after it, the low cut-off frequency is f = 1 ÷ (2π × 10KΩ × 3.3µF) ≈ 4.8 Hz, so the whole audio range passes.
Decoupling and smoothing near ICs, op-amps and regulators
RC timing circuits with 555 timers and oscillators
Replacement part in power supplies, amplifiers and appliances
For long life, use the capacitor at a working voltage comfortably below 50V.
Electrolytic capacitors are not meant for AC across their terminals; for AC or bipolar signals use a non-polarised capacitor.
